name: mixed-cluster-01
prompt: Create ONE transparent RGBA forest cluster sprite for City Forge V3. Reference 1 is the approved five-fir cluster: match its realistic pre-rendered detailed foliage, fine branches, forest-green palette, daylight, shallow orthographic camera and translucent ground shadows. References 2-4 show the game's oak, ash and maple for botanical character. Generate a NEW mixed grove of EXACTLY FIVE individual trees, five discernible trunks/crowns, using the species and arrangement specified below. Deciduous trees MUST have broad branching rounded or irregular leafy crowns, visibly distinct from the needle-leaved conical firs. Summer green foliage, subtle natural differences in green, no autumn leaves. Trees overlap naturally with some breathing room, not a row, not identical copies, not radial symmetry. Camera orthographic with 20-degree elevation above horizontal and 45-degree ground azimuth. Vertical trees, roots on same invisible horizontal plane. Soft semi-transparent ground contact and cast shadows to lower right, upper-left daylight. Transparent background including gaps, no terrain island, no soil or grass base, no baked checkerboard, no black/white backdrop. Entire trees AND shadows inside square canvas with generous padding. Photographic game asset quality like approved firs, no painterly style or low-poly shapes, no labels. This is a single flora item, not separate panels. Two firs (one tall rear-left, one medium rear-right), one broad mature oak mid-left, one airy ash mid-right, one smaller maple foreground-center. Compact asymmetric triangular footprint.
